toolboxes.name: UniHarmony
toolboxes.description: A unified Python package bundling ComBat and several of its extensions alongside interpolation- and optimal-transport-based harmonization methods behind one consistent interface.

toolboxes.name: neuroHarmonize
toolboxes.description: Python package built around ComBat-GAM (nonlinear covariate modeling via generalized additive models), also bundling standard neuroComBat and CovBat as selectable harmonization options.

toolboxes.name: ComBatFamily (R)
toolboxes.description: R package unifying ComBat and its location/scale extensions (CovBat, ComBatLS) under one modeling framework and a consistent API, rather than three separate scripts.

toolboxes.name: Intensity Normalization
toolboxes.description: General-purpose Python toolbox for MR image intensity normalization, bundling several classical (pre-ComBat-era) algorithms — including WhiteStripe, Nyúl–Udupa histogram matching, and a RAVEL-style approach — behind one CLI/API. This is why those methods' pages link to the same repo: it's the same shared implementation, not a data error.

toolboxes.name: NeuroHarm-kit
toolboxes.description: Dockerized, open-source framework that unifies end-to-end execution of five deep-learning harmonization methods behind one CLI, bundling pretrained weights for all of them so nothing needs to be trained or fine-tuned from scratch.
